prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single “best” lawyer — the right choice depends on the specifics of your crash and what you want (fast settlement vs. trial-ready litigation, catastrophic injuries, uninsured motorist claims, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best attorney for your situation and tell you how to judge them.

Quick questions so I can narrow recommendations:
- What ZIP code or part of Houston are you in/want attorneys near?
- How serious were the injuries/property damage?
- Is fault disputed or is the other driver uninsured/underinsured?
- Do you want an attorney who will take the case to trial if necessary?
- Any preferences (language, fee structure, female attorney, budget)?

How to choose the best personal injury lawyer for a car wreck
- Relevant experience: substantial experience with car wreck cases and similar injuries. Prefer lawyers who handle auto collisions frequently.
- Trial experience / track record: look for significant settlements/verdicts in Houston or Harris County.
- Board certification: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong plus.
- Contingency fee & costs: most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Ask about fees and who pays case costs if you don’t win.
- Communication & availability: clear point of contact and timely updates.
- Resources: investigator access, medical experts, and litigation support for tougher cases.
- Reputation and discipline record: check reviews and the State Bar of Texas for any disciplinary history.
- Free consultation: use it to compare 3–5 attorneys.

Where to find and verify attorneys
- State Bar of Texas lawyer search (verify license and discipline)
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (for board certification)
- Local rankings/reviews: Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Google/Yelp, and client reviews
- Houston Trial Lawyers Association / Texas Trial Lawyers Association

Important legal note
- Statute of limitations in Texas: generally 2 years from the date of the crash for personal injury claims. If you may have a case, start contacting attorneys now.

What I can do for you now
- If you give your ZIP code and a bit of case detail I can pull together a short list (3–5) of well-regarded Houston personal injury attorneys/firms that match your needs, with notes on trial experience, fees, and how to contact them.
- Or I can send a short checklist of questions to ask at free consultations.

Which would you prefer?
